cause: The new runtime bootstrap and two new probe runners assumed that freeze_config preserves each registry parameter's status/value envelope. Frozen snapshots instead expose the raw parameter value directly under snapshot.values.
proposed_resolution: Create an implementation-only successor that reads the raw values mapping used by every emitted frozen snapshot, rehashes all three files, reruns local tests, and uses a fresh stage snapshot. Preserve the failed v3 staging files and never classify them as a scientific attempt.
